function: Excluded as no_learning: the CSI estimator is off-grid structured sparse Bayesian learning solved by EM iterations on each observation, with no trained model; the detectors are CS-based or closed-form ML (pp. 1, 6, 8, 9).
notes: no_learning. p. 1: 'off-grid structured-sparse Bayesian learning-based CSI estimator'. p. 8: 'We adopt the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm' to estimate the prior precisions of the sparse model, a per-observation Bayesian EM iteration with no offline training, dataset, or network. The secondary-information detectors are compressed-sensing algorithms (p. 6: 'orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP), compressive sampling matching pursuit (CoSaMP), and iterative hard thresholding (IHT)'). The primary detector SWIC is a symbol-wise ML detector with interference cancellation and a closed-form phase rounding, Eq. (50) (p. 9: 'does not require any iteration'). The full text has no neural network, training, learned parameters, or dataset. The work would otherwise sit in area 4 (OTFS), with a single-antenna BS and user and an IRS (p. 2), and it reports simulation results (pp. 10-11), but no_learning is the first applicable code.
